meta.description: Thin-wall GCR response kernel R=D_organ/Phi_ff, cal_material=evasuit. Regenerated by lunarsim.kernel_gen.
meta.quantity: R = D_organ / Phi_ff  (Gy*cm^2); q in D=absorbed, I=ICRP-60 dose-eq
meta.note: VALIDATED REGIME: thin-wall (<=2.025 g/cm^2), penetrating energies -- reproduces committed Al kernel to 0.9-1.25x. Not calibrated for thick walls (>=10 g/cm^2) or range-threshold low-E cells; the EVA grid lies entirely within the validated band. NASA/Cucinotta Q twin (N) not present -- thin-wall kernel carries only absorbed (D) and ICRP-60 (I); the thin-wall headline is ICRP-60 effective dose.
